summary: The candidate coalesces touching row segments and fixes the reported shared-boundary-page assertion, including the reported page_size=64 boundary at 32704. It passes its focused CPU and ROCm GPU regressions and independent interleaved/gapped cases. However, cleanup is not idempotent: retrying the same free_kv_row_segments call adds the same pages to the allocator free list again. Because retry safety was an explicit review objective, this is a partial fix and changes are requested.

native_rebuild_reason: Not applicable: the candidate changes Python and Python tests only; no native, C++, FlyDSL, compiler, or ISA source changed.
remaining_counterexamples: Calling free_kv_row_segments twice with the same touching ranges is not idempotent: the second call inserts the same physical pages into PagedTokenToKVPoolAllocator.free_pages again (baseline+2 becomes baseline+4).
remaining_limitations: The prepared host has one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) with ROCm 7.2, not the reported 8x NVIDIA B300 (SM103) CUDA deployment, so the full Kimi-K3 multi-rank server reproduction and CUDA architecture were not available.

No Kimi-K3 or DSpark model weights and no eight-GPU topology were provided; validation therefore exercised the real Python allocator/free path and focused hybrid SWA GPU allocator test rather than the production server launch.
Raw logs and the independent adversarial test are retained outside the checkout at /job/review-evidence-j-4e801a8d51a9.
